name: Viha Dikonda
why: Viha is the presenter in 70% of posts — the child-led format behind LJ-004 (the account's best ad, ₹140 per purchase) and LJ-050.
Her single most-played recent post is Viha trying to speak Hindi in a Telugu accent (6.5M plays), so a Hindi script plays to an existing strength rather than against her voice.
She already films Viha eating and reacting to food (e.g. the restaurant spicy-food reaction, 3.3M plays).
Bonus signal (not scored): the audience file lists Little Joys among her past-year brands, and her audience is 30% women.
Followers 827,496; typical video reach 771k-3,096k plays (middle half of their last 16 videos).
hook: Viha, to camera, holding her plate, in her Telugu-accented Hindi: "Aaj dekho meri plate mein kya kya hai!" On screen: "Viha ki roti mein ek secret hai 🤫". Spoken and on-screen together (LJ-004 opened the same way; ads with a spoken + on-screen hook did better).
script: Viha with her lunch plate, spoken + text hook (above).
Cut to Mom's hands adding one scoop of Proteinmix to the atta; Viha peeks in suspiciously.
Viha bites the roti, does her signature exaggerated chewing face, then: "Taste toh bilkul same hai!" This is the core moment — a real child genuinely tasting on camera.
Mom voiceover (Hinglish): 12g plant protein in one scoop, from pea, brown rice and soy; no added sugar, no preservatives.
Viha asks for a second roti; packshot with "Little Joys Proteinmix" on screen.

Proteinmix: no change in taste or smell of roti / pancakes
Proteinmix: made from pea, brown rice and soy protein

avoid: An adult script read by Viha about nutrients (her profile: an adult reading marketing copy feels foreign).
Studio lighting; keep the home-video look.
Height / 'overall growth' promises and deficiency fear (both did worse in the ads).
Telugu as the only version — no Telugu ad has ever been tested; regional-language ads cost 2.0x as much per purchase.
format: 30-35s Reel, 9:16, home setting, Hindi/Hinglish. Produce a Telugu cut of the same video as an A/B test.
expected: No ad by this creator exists, so there is no direct measurement. The estimate comes from the 12 Little Joys ads built the same way (child reacts to taste on camera + English/Hinglish + milk-mix product).
Those ads cost ₹200 per purchase together (90% range ₹160-₹380), versus ₹410 for the whole account. Without the single best ad (LJ-004) it is ₹330 (₹280-₹450).
Individual ads in that group ranged from ₹140 to ₹730: execution matters as much as the recipe. Read this as 'likely at or better than the account average', not a forecast.
Organic reach: their typical video gets 771k-3,096k plays; too few sponsored videos to say whether sponsored posts get fewer plays.
